description.value: Local Pizza is a Vancouver Island-founded pizza chain emphasizing fresh ingredients and local ownership, with multiple locations across the island and into Victoria and Vancouver. The Nanaimo Terminal Avenue outlet offers both pickup and delivery, with an online ordering system. The chain leans into its BC roots, branding itself as run by local employees serving neighbourhood-style pizzas.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Local Pizza is an active Vancouver Island pizza chain; the locations subpage explicitly lists 'Terminal 650 Terminal Ave PICKUP Delivery', corroborating the OSM address. Takeout and online ordering are prominently featured throughout the site. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza restaurant confirmed by an active website with online ordering and an explicit listing of the Terminal Avenue Nanaimo location; OSM check_date of 2025-10-08 further supports it is open.

wow_evidence: Vancouver Island-founded pizza chain with multiple locations across the island and into Victoria and Vancouver
